verdict.rationale: Elastic documents fast paths to a first search. A one-line `curl | sh` start-local script sets up Elasticsearch and Kibana in Docker, and a free serverless trial is offered for new users. The semantic search docs say you only need to create an index mapping to start ingesting and querying, with no model settings or pipelines. A community report says new documents may not appear in search results until the index refreshes, which can slow a 'first search' unless configured. Another calls the docs hard for newcomers, which lowers confidence rather than contradicting the quickstart. Missing for 10: an explicit step-by-step quickstart for index creation, adding documents and a first query; evidence of the 'within minutes' timing; independent hands-on corroboration.
